text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the dream grand stage, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe,
finally right before her eyes,
Gold Ship is—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, babyyyyy!!!!
Here we are, arrived in Paris!!
Now I run, am running, shall runnnn!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was completely over the moon.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The Seine River... I wish I could've brought my buddy, the blue-green damselfish, along too—
Damn it, if only it weren't a saltwater fish...
choice_data_list: H-Hold on, calm down a bit...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Can't do it! I'm way too hyped and excited!
When I get like this,
even I can't stop myself!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So with that, first one to the Louvre wins!
I'm gonna get a big fat smooch
from little Miss Nike of Samothrace!
choice_data_list: This is bad, we have to chase after them—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how whimsical Gold Ship is,
don't tell me she's completely in tourist mode
and forgot all about the race...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a sliver of anxiety in my heart,
I chased after a rampaging Gold Ship all over Paris,
and before I knew it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having completely lost sight of Gold Ship,
I found myself all alone and lost.
choice_data_list: (Am I just going to drop dead like this—?)
(Am I just going to die out here like this——?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As you hang your head and look down, something shining white on the ground catches your eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For some reason, there are scallop shells scattered along the ground like trail markers...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand a single thing,
but when it comes to not understanding things,
that's Gold Ship for you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You have done well to make it here,
Hero <username>.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
As a reward, Lady Golshi shall grant you
just one wish—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having barely made it this far with my life, there's only one thing I can think of.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's obvious, ain't it?
That's why we came all the way from Japan in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (FLAP!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A delightfully hilarious race where the most interesting folks from across the globe gather,
and nobody has any clue what's gonna happen!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm so pumped up, I can't sit still for even a second!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So, what's yer wish?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm askin' ya what the hell ya wanna see
in the most delightful race in the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In that case, what I should wish for is—
choice_data_list: I wanna see Gold Ship, the most entertaining Uma Musume in the world!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Your wish has been heard and granted—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Open your eyes wide and take a good look!
